description.p: Folio is a native GTK 4 note-taking application for GNOME. Notes are written in a strict subset of AsciiDoc and rendered live into a clean, readable page; malformed markup reports a precise error instead of rendering silently wrong.
The whole library is a single SQLite database under the XDG data directory — no account, no cloud, no telemetry.

ul.li: Source and rendered views of every note, toggled from the toolbar
Headings, lists, tables, code blocks, quotes, callouts, links and images
Tag-based organisation with multi-tag (AND) filtering and live search
File attachments: notes carry attached files, shown as a card grid and linkable from the note body.
Search moved into the header bar, with a clearer empty state when no note matches.
Keyboard shortcuts for the common actions.
Dark mode fixes, including the source editor palette.
Edits are flushed to the library before the window closes.
A Debian package with desktop and icon integration.
